task.title: Stay connected with a match
task.shortdesc: A match fades 30 minutes after you part. If you both tap Stay connected, you keep each other.

step.cmd: On Stay connected with name?, tap Stay connected.
step.stepresult: Your button reads Waiting for name. They get one notification: name would like to stay connected.

taskbody.result: When you have both tapped it, you see You and name are connected and their card shows Connected. You keep each other's profile, chat, stories, and posts.

postreq.p: A request waits up to 7 days. If they don't tap it too, nothing changes.
To end a connection, open the Match screen, tap the … menu, then tap Remove connection. They won't be told.
